entries.title: General hospital hours
entries.text: Riverside General's emergency department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Outpatient clinics and departments are open Monday through Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM, and closed on Sundays except for emergencies.

entries.title: Pharmacy hours
entries.text: The Riverside General outpatient pharmacy is open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 7 PM, and Saturday 9 AM to 2 PM. It is closed on Sundays. The inpatient pharmacy serving admitted patients operates 24 hours a day.

entries.title: Cardiology department
entries.text: The Cardiology department at Riverside General handles heart and cardiovascular care, including checkups, ECGs, and follow-up care. Doctors: Dr. Imran Malik and Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui. Located on the 3rd floor of the main building.

entries.title: General medicine department
entries.text: The General Medicine department handles routine checkups, general illness, referrals to specialists, and ongoing care for adult patients. Doctor: Dr. Bilal Ahmed. Located on the 1st floor of the main building.

entries.title: Pediatrics department
entries.text: The Pediatrics department handles care for infants, children, and teenagers, including checkups and vaccinations. Doctor: Dr. Sana Farooqi. Located on the 2nd floor of the main building.

entries.title: Dr. Imran Malik - Cardiology
entries.text: Dr. Imran Malik is a cardiologist at Riverside General specializing in general adult cardiology and preventive heart care. Fluent in English and Urdu. Sees patients Monday through Friday.

entries.title: Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui - Cardiology
entries.text: Dr. Ayesha Siddiqui is a cardiologist at Riverside General with a focus on cardiac rehabilitation and follow-up care after cardiac events. Fluent in English and Punjabi. Sees patients Tuesday through Saturday.

entries.title: Dr. Bilal Ahmed - General medicine
entries.text: Dr. Bilal Ahmed is a general medicine physician at Riverside General, seeing adult patients for routine checkups, illness, and referrals. Fluent in English and Urdu.

entries.title: Dr. Sana Farooqi - Pediatrics
entries.text: Dr. Sana Farooqi is a pediatrician at Riverside General, seeing patients from infancy through age 17, including vaccination schedules and routine wellness checks. Fluent in English and Sindhi.

entries.title: Accepted insurance
entries.text: Riverside General accepts most major insurance plans, including Blue Cross Blue Shield, Aetna, Cigna, and UnitedHealth. Patients without insurance can ask about the self-pay rate and financial assistance program when they arrive.

entries.title: Billing and payment
entries.text: Billing statements are mailed or emailed within two weeks of a visit. Payments can be made online, by phone, or in person at the billing office on the 1st floor. Payment plans are available on request.

entries.title: Prescription refill process
entries.text: To request a prescription refill, patients can call the pharmacy directly or ask their doctor's office to send a refill request. Refills typically take 1 to 2 business days to process.

entries.title: Visitor policy
entries.text: Visiting hours for admitted patients are 10 AM to 8 PM daily. Each patient may have up to two visitors at a time. Children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult at all times.

entries.title: Getting lab results
entries.text: Lab results are typically available within 3 to 5 business days and can be accessed through the patient portal or by calling the department that ordered the test.

entries.title: Parking and directions
entries.text: Riverside General has a visitor parking garage attached to the main building, with the first hour free and a flat daily rate after that. Valet parking is available at the main entrance on weekdays.
